name: I LOST IT
tagline: Lost-and-found search that matches photos and descriptions four ways at once.

awards: SAP - Sponsor Challenge // SAP - Défi commandité

problem: Owners search lost-and-found bins by hand with vague descriptions.
solution: Runs image-to-image, image-to-caption, text-to-image and text-to-text matching in parallel with DINOv2 and CLIP over a vector database, then asks follow-up questions with Gemini.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a photo and see matches from each method.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “SAP - Sponsor Challenge // SAP - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Uses several matching methods instead of one.

lessons: Show the ensemble; judges reward visible depth on a crowded brief.
